description: Reboots a running server's machine; players are disconnected for a minute or two while it boots and fetches its content from Modrinth, CurseForge or their download links. Use it for a pending size change or a stuck server; for changed game settings use restartToApplySettings. A restore queued with restoreBackup replaces the world during the reboot, and the restart needs enough account balance for the server's size. Fails unless the server is running (use startServer); returns the server.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: restartServer
title: Restart a whole server
